audience.rationale: Required by the objective, not inferred from an artifact: the hook only lands on a viewer who has met the word 'token' without ever learning what one is — the exact position of the general public that uses chat AI, sees tokens priced, windows measured in tokens, and headlines counted in quadrillions of them. The lane confirms the address: Word Definitions writes for a first-time viewer of the term (canon audience: general public, plain words; GOAL.md series rules). The misconception is the one the definition corrects: a token is a word.
audience.record: GOAL.md (audience: general public) + the phase-1 objective (this file)
audience.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 1, 2026-10-26) — required by the phase-1 objective; the lane's audience pattern as corroboration
audience.value: The general-public viewer who uses a chat AI and keeps meeting the word 'token' — in prices, in 'context window' talk, in headlines about quadrillions of them — without knowing what one token is. The misconception the piece corrects: 'A token is basically a word (or some kind of coin or code).'

delivery_structure.rationale: Derived from the moves and the doctrine (files/pause-transition-doctrine.md: F1 line transition 400–600 ms; F2 concept shift 800–1,200 ms; F3 after a question, viewer-think 1,200–2,000 ms; F4 before a reveal/payoff 700–1,200 ms; F7 intra-line breath 150–400 ms, engine-owned by punctuation): the think beat belongs after M2 because that is the piece's only genuine question; the two F4 suspenses guard the two performed payoffs (the count, the return); the F2 shift separates what a token COSTS (M6) from what it MEANS (M7) — the arc's hinge. Everything else stays at statement pace: a definition does not breathe between its steps.
delivery_structure.record: transcript/delivery.md (phase 3 — the pause map) + transcript/transcript.md (the settled text)
delivery_structure.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 2, 2026-10-26), derived from the phase-2 story structure + files/pause-transition-doctrine.md
delivery_structure.value: Definition cadence over the eight moves, sized from the pause doctrine's classes: lead-in 2.00 s (the monument assembles in the clear before the voice — the hook's visual half is a delivery event, not dead air) → statement (M1) → F1 joint 0.50 s → the question (M2) → F3 VIEWER-THINK BEAT 1.30 s (the piece's one long pause, spent where the doctrine spends it: after the question, before the correction) → definition (M3) → F1 0.50 s → machine's eye + rule (M4) → F4 SUSPENSE 0.90 s → the performed count (M5; its internal rhythm is performed — each counted word isolated by its periods, engine gaps at the top of the F7 range) → F1 0.50 s → stakes (M6, list rhythm) → F2 CONCEPT SHIFT 1.00 s → the turn (M7) → F4 SUSPENSE 0.90 s → the return (M8) → 0.80 s hold → silent bridge over bed only. Inter-line sizes are decided here as classes and embodied as the pause map in transcript/delivery.md (phase 3). The music bed is continuous throughout — pauses are narration events, never bed cuts (the owner's standing rule).

end_referral.rationale: The referral is derived from the content, not inherited from the delivered build's packaging (its bridge pointed at the direction piece, a thread the owner cut from this piece's arc in 2026-10-22's T-16 critique): M7 leaves the viewer watching a stream of tokens moving as the machine's thought-in-progress — that stream, the material the machine works in and keeps producing, is the context; the convinced viewer's next question is necessarily what that stream IS, and WD-04 is the lane piece that answers it. Weighed: WD-02 'What Is a Prompt?' — a prompt is indeed made of tokens, but wd-02's own concept (direction, accumulated) never needs the token; the object on screen at this piece's close is a stream, not a direction, so context is the honest next definition. Card-only and silent so the bookend is never talked over.
end_referral.record: phase-2 story_structure (this file); scene/scene.json compartment C8 (phase 4)
end_referral.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 2, 2026-10-26), from the phase-2 story structure (M7's stream) + the lane's map
end_referral.value: Silent bridge card in the tail, over the held bookend: 'NEXT — the stream those tokens move in / WHAT IS CONTEXT? →'. Target: WD-04 'What Is Context?' (Word Definitions lane). Bed only, no narration; navigation load = the card's ~3 s tail, 0% of the narration.

hook_form.rationale: The hook's first second must be scale, not scaffolding: a full grammatical opener ('Every month, Google's machines process more than…') spends that second on the frame before the figure arrives; the fragment puts the figure first and lets the anchor follow inside the same breath. 'More than' is kept because the sourced figure is a floor, not an exact count — the honesty of the hook is part of its form. Weighed and rejected: the lane's cold-question opener (the delivered build's 'Quick: what is a token?') — the owner replaced it with the number this morning (2026-10-26), and a cold question cannot carry the opening promise the bookend needs: M8 must return to something with scale, and a question has none. The full-sentence variant is drafted and weighed as Candidate A at phase 3.
hook_form.record: phase-1 objective (this file); scene/scene.json compartment C1 (phase 4)
hook_form.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 2, 2026-10-26), from the phase-1 objective + the owner's structure direction (2026-10-26)
hook_form.value: The sourced number as a bare fragment, first: 'More than three point two quadrillion.' lands alone — the figure at monumental scale (cinematic typography, phase-2 style) — and the same line's second sentence anchors it: whose machines, what counted, how often. No question is asked cold; the number IS the entry (the owner's structure), and the definition question follows from it at M2.

message.rationale: The message is the definition compressed to its repeatable form: chunk (what it is) + of text (its material) + the machine counts (its role — everything downstream of the piece, stakes included, is counting). Each half is load-bearing: drop 'chunk' and the viewer keeps the word-picture; drop 'the machine counts' and the hook's quadrillion has nothing to attach to. The wording descends from the piece's settled essence (the definition the owner never faulted — his 2026-10-26 verdict scored the delivered video's structure and style, 'absolutely zero style in this video as an explainer', not its definition); it is adopted here because the derivation re-checks out from the objective directly, not because an earlier script carried it.
message.record: the phase-1 objective (this file); the settled essence's history is evidence, cited in transcript/consolidation.md (phase 3)
message.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 1, 2026-10-26), from the lane's purpose (Word Definitions: define the term for a first-time viewer) + the objective
message.value: A token is a chunk of text the machine counts. (Viewer restatement: 'A token isn't a word — it's a piece of text, often part of a word, that the machine reads, counts, bills, and turns into numbers.')

objective.rationale: Derived from the piece's purpose, not from any earlier artifact: wd-01 is the Word Definitions lane's definition of 'token', the unit every other Academy term is measured in. The objective is stated as the viewer change the definition must produce, in the shape the owner's structure direction (2026-10-26) prescribes: the viewer arrives unable to say what one token is — the hook's number is noise to them — and must leave able to say it, so the same number, returned at the close, reads as a fact instead of a noise. 17 words. The two halves are the owner's bookend stated as a success condition: the definition (the chunk, counted) and the scale made legible (the quadrillion makes sense).
objective.record: the owner's structure direction for this piece (2026-10-26: start with the quadrillions Google processes monthly, use the number as the entry into what a token is, and come back to it at the end — bookend), quoted in transcript/consolidation.md (phase 3)
objective.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 1, 2026-10-26) — from the lane's purpose (Word Definitions: define the term for a first-time viewer) + the owner's structure direction for this piece (2026-10-26)
objective.value: Teach that a token is the chunk of text a machine counts — until the quadrillion makes sense.

role.rationale: The lane's division of labour: a Word Definitions piece introduces its term completely inside its own minute, because the funnel cannot presume viewing order. The objective is a definition-transfer (the viewer leaves able to say what a token is and to feel its scale), which is INTRODUCE work, not APPLY work — no doctrine is applied here; the unit itself is the payload.
role.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 2, 2026-10-26), from the phase-1 objective + the lane's role pattern
role.value: INTRODUCE — define the word 'token' for a first-time viewer. The piece presumes nothing from any other video: it is the lane's first definition and the unit the later definitions silently use, so it must be complete inside its own minute.

scene_decomposition.rationale: The inventory is prescribed from the architecture (phase 2), not enumerated from a shipped file: each compartment exists because a move requires a visual event, and the continuity law exists because the objective's argument is about the SAME unit in every role — if the pieces were re-drawn per beat, the unit would be illustrated instead of learned. One focal group at a time (the style decision). Embodied element-by-element in phase 4 (scene/scene.json).
scene_decomposition.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 2, 2026-10-26), derived from the phase-2 story structure
scene_decomposition.value: ONE self-contained HTML file (the MP4 renders from this file alone), decomposed into compartments that follow the eight moves: C1 THE MONUMENT — the number as cinematic typography: ghosted '3.2' + gold QUADRILLION + the source line 'Google I/O 2026'; three states (arrival at full scale, M1 → receded header through M2–M7 → return at full scale with the digit expansion 3,200,000,000,000,000 and ONE token piece lit inside it, M8) · C2 THE QUESTION TILE — a lone dashed outline tile, 'ONE TOKEN?', waiting empty (M2) · C3 THE CUT — the word 'unhappiness' as one wide tile, bracket cuts chopping it into un / happi / ness token pieces; a whole-word tile stands beside them uncut (M3) · C4 THE MACHINE'S EYE — the token pieces pass under a scanner gate labelled by the claim; the rule chip '≈ 4 CHARACTERS EACH' (M4) · C5 THE COUNT — the counted sentence's five pieces land one per spoken word; a counter ticks and locks on 5, gold (M5) · C6 THE STAKES — four stake tiles (READS / WRITES / YOU PAY / HOLDS AT ONCE), each lighting at its spoken beat, each carrying the token pieces as its counter (M6) · C7 THE STREAM — the pieces flow as a continuous ribbon, the machine thinking (M7) · C8 THE BRIDGE CARD (the referral). Plus the standing compartments: the stage void, the lane furniture, the word-animation layer (the narration's words as objects in the picture; monument mode for L1/L8, band mode otherwise), the audio compartment, and the in-page decision-record layer. SEMANTIC CONTINUITY IS THE SCENE'S LAW: the pieces cut at C3 are the pieces counted at C5, carried at C6, flowed at C7, and one stands lit inside the returned number at C1/M8 — no fresh decoration per beat.

story_structure.rationale: Each move exists because the objective requires it, in this order: the scale must be felt before the unit can matter (M1); an undefined thing counted in quadrillions forces the definition question in the viewer's own voice (M2); the definition corrects the audience's standing misconception (token = word), so correction is its form (M3); a definition of a machine-unit is incomplete until the machine's viewpoint replaces the reader's (M4); the countability claimed in M4 must be performed, not asserted — the viewer counting is the proof, and the counted sentence states the piece's thesis while being counted (M5); a unit matters only through what it measures, so the stakes convert the count into consequence (M6); the turn is the owner's destination — the unit re-seen as the medium of machine thought, which is what makes the monthly quadrillion a story about now (M7); the return closes the promise the opening made — the same figure, re-heard with the unit known, is the recall device, and it is the piece's ONLY close (M8). The overall shape is the owner's direction (2026-10-26); the move-by-move motivation is prescribed here from the objective.
story_structure.record: phase-1 objective (this file); embodied in transcript/transcript.md (phase 3) and scene/scene.json (phase 4)
story_structure.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 2, 2026-10-26), derived from the phase-1 objective + the owner's bookend direction for this piece (2026-10-26)
story_structure.value: Eight moves in the owner's bookend: M1 THE NUMBER — the sourced figure at full scale, fragment first ('More than three point two quadrillion.'), then anchored inside the same line (Google's machines, every month). The opening promise is structural: a number too big to mean anything will be made to mean something by defining ONE of its units. M2 THE QUESTION — the number earns the definition question: 'So what is one token?' M3 THE DEFINITION — by correction: not a word; a chunk of text, sometimes a whole word, often just a piece of one; a word is seen breaking into pieces. M4 THE MACHINE'S EYE + THE RULE — the machine reads tokens, not letters and not words; in English, about four characters each: the unit is countable. M5 THE COUNT, PERFORMED — the viewer counts a sentence into tokens with the voice ('The. Machine. Reads. Tokens.' — five, the fifth the full stop): the claim proved by doing. M6 THE STAKES — everything is measured in tokens: what the model reads, what it writes, what you pay, how much it can hold at once. M7 THE TURN — right now, machines that think in language think in tokens: the unit is the medium of thought, and the pieces become a moving stream. M8 THE RETURN — the bookend: the figure again, in the hook's own words; now every unit inside it is known: 'Now you know what one is.' The question the video answers (viewer-voiced): 'Three point two quadrillion tokens a month — what is ONE token?' NARRATIVE ARCHITECTURE, designed on purpose (the owner's iteration-3 demand on wd-02, applied here from his words): OPENING PROMISE — M1+M2 state it (a meaningless scale, a question aimed at one unit) and M8 pays it word-for-word ('what one is' answers 'what is one token?'); MOTIVATED TRANSITIONS — every move is the previous move's consequence (number → the question the number forces → the definition the question asks for → the viewpoint the definition implies → the proof the claim needs → the stakes the count governs → the meaning the stakes add up to → the scale re-heard); ARC — SCALE → UNIT → SCALE (awe → curiosity → mastery → awe-with-understanding); RECALL — the bookend itself: the hook's figure returns near-verbatim, and the definition is recalled inside it.

style_direction.rationale: The mix is derived from the jobs the objective assigns style: (a) the concept is a UNIT story — one small object whose roles multiply (read, written, billed, held, thought in) — so the spine must be an object that persists and changes role (motion graphics under the A59 grammar; timed word appearance alone cannot be counted, stacked or streamed); (b) the number is the piece's verdict-weight object at both ends, and the menu's instrument for verdict weight is cinematic type — rationed to it alone so the monument stays singular; (c) the definition's whole claim (a token is often a PIECE of a word) is a visible cut, and flat 2D is the hand that cuts cleanly. Whiteboard weighed and rejected: its classroom-sketch register argues against the monument's weight, a drawn line cannot carry the cutout object-identity the continuity law requires, and this piece's own whiteboard specimen stands under the owner's still-open judgment #79 — building in it would pre-judge his verdict. Collage rejected: texture noise competes with the word layer. 3D / isometric rejected: the object of the piece is a flat chunk of text; depth would decorate, not teach. Both adopted styles are in the owner's starting set (#77).
style_direction.record: files/a59-motion-brief.md — LANE VERDICT (#78) + transferable grammar + STYLE MENU RULING (#77); embodied in scene/scene.json (phase 4)
style_direction.source: owner verdict #78 via files/a59-motion-brief.md (LANE VERDICT) — the lane input; archer reasoning (this branch, phase 2, 2026-10-26) for this piece's mix, from the phase-1 objective + files/a59-motion-brief.md (grammar + #77 starting set)
style_direction.value: LANE INPUT (owner-decided): the A59 grammar is the adopted direction for the Word Definitions lane — the owner's verdict #78 (2026-10-26), won on wd-02's exp-01 specimens (Variant B, 'more artistic'): independent textured cutouts on a dark void, one focal group, principal-word entry grammar (rise 24 units, scale 0.82→1 over 0.28 s, cubic ease-out), entries on the media clock at spoken words, SEMANTIC CONTINUITY as the core law. THIS PIECE'S MIX, decided against the objective: (1) a MOTION GRAPHICS spine under the A59 grammar — ONE persistent object system, the TOKEN PIECE (a text-chunk tile): the viewer learns a single object and watches it change role, because the objective's whole work is making one unit known; (2) CINEMATIC TYPOGRAPHY rationed to exactly one object — the number (hook + bookend): ghosted '3.2' behind a gold QUADRILLION monument, one object in three states (arrival → receded header → return with the digit expansion 3,200,000,000,000,000), because the owner's structure makes the number the entry AND the return, so it must be the piece's only monument; (3) 2D GRAPHICS as the rendering hand for the definition moment — the word 'unhappiness' lands as one wide flat tile and is visibly cut into un / happi / ness, because that is the one moment that must be SEEN to be learned. Semantic continuity, prescribed: the cut pieces of M3 are the same objects counted at M5, carried as the stakes' counters at M6, flowed as the thinking-stream at M7, and one of them stands lit inside the returned number at M8.

scaffold_note: Decision scaffold for the FROM-SCRATCH rebuild of wd-01, opened 2026-10-26 (JOB REBUILD-WD01) under the owner's from-scratch order of the same day. This branch starts empty; nothing from the first build (branch video/wd-01 and the workspace records behind it) is copied as settled. The first build is EVIDENCE — consulted last, only for facts, raw material and what to avoid. Under the causal rule, every decision here cites the objective, the canon (files/canon.md) or the owner's recorded teachings as its source. Phase 1 decides the idea-level fields: objective, message, audience. The rest stands honestly OPEN with named routes. THE STRUCTURE THIS PIECE MUST TAKE IS THE OWNER'S OWN, directed 2026-10-26 after he scored the delivered video '10 at most' ('absolutely zero style in this video as an explainer'): start with something exciting — the quadrillions of tokens Google processes every month — use that number as the ENTRY into what a token is, explain the token, arrive at 'right now our machines processing language are thinking in tokens — this many quadrillion tokens a month', and COME BACK TO the number at the end (bookend). The hook figure is sourced: more than 3.2 quadrillion tokens per month, Sundar Pichai, Google I/O 2026 keynote; trajectory 9.7 trillion/month (2024) → 480 trillion (2025) → 3.2 quadrillion (2026); the scope distinction (processed ≠ unique generated text) is part of the fact and is carried in the narration's verb. PHASE 2 (2026-10-26): architecture prescribed from the phase-1 objective under the owner's bookend — role, story structure (eight moves + the narrative architecture: opening promise, motivated transitions, the SCALE → UNIT → SCALE arc, recall by bookend), hook form, style direction (the lane's A59 adoption recorded as an owner-decided input, #78; this piece's mix decided against the objective), delivery pattern (pause-doctrine classes), end referral (derived from M7's stream) and scene form are all decided as prescription, not read off the first build. Scaffold 10/10. PHASE 3 (2026-10-26): transcript consolidated in the open — Candidate A drafted fresh from the phase-2 architecture FIRST (9 lines / 131 words), Candidate B (this morning's redevelopment draft i3, built under the owner's structure direction) weighed second with provenance, the delivered text read LAST as evidence only; settled text 8 lines / 127 spoken words with the per-line account, the narrative architecture made explicit, the editor pass, and the pause map (transcript/delivery.md). PHASE 4 (2026-10-26): the scene authored to the phase-2 prescription as ONE self-contained HTML file (30 elements, compartments C1–C8 with homes; the token piece persistent across C3/C4/C7; word animation in the stage's empty band, no caption plate); 16 QA frames viewed, six defects found and fixed, 9 frames re-shot and verified.
